summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst under Utilities, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Line lengths were checked by measurement (all under 120). Tests were not run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-object top-level JSON value is treated as a missing key; a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError; JSON decode errors propagate unchanged.
